plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Architectural Design Technology A.S. Degree - Architectural Design Technology-CalGETC' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 28, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8013/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61-63; lower bound 61 encoded = 15+15+15+16 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 3 ADT 320/ARCH 329 -> 3; Sem 4 ADT 324/ARCH 334 -> 3 and ADT 326/ARCH 332/ARCH 342 -> 3). Map notes this program also meets the requirements for the Certificate of Achievement in Building Information Modeling (BIM) and the Certificate of Achievement in Interior Building Architecture (IBA); no separate sequences are published. Semester 1 elective suggestion: ARCH 320 Architectural Design & Communication I (3.5 units), co-requisite with ARCH 325; the elective is listed at 3 units and units are needed to total 60 for graduation. ARCH 325 co-requisite per map: ARCH 320 (not a sequenced plan course; documented here, not encoded). ARCH 326 co-requisite per map: ARCH 321 (not a sequenced plan course; documented here, not encoded). ADT 322 prerequisite per map: ADT 320 or experience (ADT 320 is the Semester 3 choice-slot code). SEMESTER 4 CHOICE GROUPS: (1) ADT 324 BIM III (prerequisite per map: ADT 322 or experience; advisory ADT 310 & 320) or ARCH 334 Advanced Design in Three Dimensions (prerequisite per map: ARCH 320; advisory ARCH 321); (2) ADT 326 BIM IV (prerequisite per map: ADT 322 or equivalent; advisory ADT 310 & 320) or ARCH 332 Design Awareness (no prerequisite listed) or ARCH 342 Introduction to Green Buildings (prerequisite per map: ARCH 320 & 321, listed bare in the prerequisite column). Note: the Local GE version of this map (7821) instead lists ARCH 320 & 321 as the prerequisite for ARCH 332; transcribed here as printed. Option-specific prerequisites are documented here rather than encoded on the choice slots, because the 'or experience'/'or equivalent' alternatives and the ARCH 320/321 suggested-elective prerequisites do not map to single plan courses. Other advisories: ADT 310 advisory ADT 300 & 302; ADT 320 advisory ADT 310; ARCH 329 advisory ARCH 321 & 326. CalGETC Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
